# Arin Handyman and Contracting

> Home repairs and renovations across Halton and the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada. The site includes researched homeowner guides.

The service categories shown are handyman repairs, drywall and finishing, painting and refreshes, carpentry and details, flooring and tile, kitchen and bath updates, and basement framing and drywall. Listed communities include Milton, Mississauga, Oakville, Brampton, Burlington, and Toronto.

Project enquiries: (416) 455-0606 or arin@youssefian.com. The website displays these contact details with tap-to-call and email links; it has no contact form, booking, or payment system. The site does not establish verified trade licences, credentials, reviews, prices, or guarantees.

Home notes articles provide general planning guidance, with numbered source citations and deliberate publication, update, and source-check dates. Read each article's qualifications and original sources before relying on guidance for a specific property or municipality.

## Business information

- [Homepage](https://arinhandyman.com/): Business overview and project enquiries.
- [Services](https://arinhandyman.com/#services): Descriptions of the service categories shown on the site.
- [Service area](https://arinhandyman.com/#areas): Halton and Greater Toronto Area communities listed on the site.
- [About Arin](https://arinhandyman.com/#about): The site's business introduction.
- [Contact](https://arinhandyman.com/#contact): Business phone number, email address, and details to include in an enquiry.

## Homeowner guides

- [Home notes](https://arinhandyman.com/blog/): Index of all researched guides.
- [A draughty door doesn’t always need replacing](https://arinhandyman.com/blog/draughty-door-repair-or-replace/): Find out where the air is getting in, then separate a worn seal from a door or frame that needs more attention.
- [The prep work that makes a paint refresh last](https://arinhandyman.com/blog/paint-preparation-that-lasts/): Cleaning, repairs, and the right primer belong in the plan before anyone opens a tin of the new colour.
- [A bathroom refresh: decide what stays before pricing what changes](https://arinhandyman.com/blog/bathroom-refresh-planning-halton/): A practical scope checklist for Halton homeowners, including where local permits and electrical requirements enter the conversation.
- [Cracked grout: when a shower needs a closer look](https://arinhandyman.com/blog/grout-repair-or-shower-leak/): Separate a tired-looking joint from a water-management problem before choosing a cosmetic repair.
